title: Binary Thresholding
learning_objectives: Create binary masks from grayscale images
Invert masks and measure foreground fraction
Apply a mask to an image
entry_point: threshold(gray, t, invert=False); foreground_fraction(mask); apply_mask(img, mask)
hints: For colour: `mask[..., None]` broadcasts over channels; use `np.where`.

failure_feedback.advice: Use strict > t (127 is not foreground at t = 127).
Broadcast the mask over channels with mask[..., None].
Return a new array (np.where) instead of assigning into img.
